scope: Reuse-first source intake and proposed dependent production stages; not the desktop campaign completion ledger.

stages.title: One coherent licensed stone material
stages.acceptance: Transfer hashes, publisher sizes/MD5, CC0 source/license and isolated Godot texture/material binding passed. Art quality and runtime promotion are separate.

stages.title: Existing Rama, courtyard and diya in one retained look-development stage
stages.acceptance: Editable source, frozen asset identities and actual day/night images independently inspected. Native-art worker owns current execution status.

stages.title: One truthful playable wind-court replacement
stages.acceptance: Follow existing W4 footprint, landing, collision, three-surface/current-material and matched-view gates; this new source material is not automatic permission for new runtime textures.

stages.title: One continuous contact-preserving hero-action sequence
stages.acceptance: Existing rig and audited transfer pipeline; matched root, feet, hand/bow, anticipation, release and recovery footage. Artist-controlled hair source remains separate.

stages.title: Promote accepted source into an exact qualified native candidate
stages.acceptance: Targeted tests, budgets, imported output, actual package play and source binding. Native authority and FG06 full3v3 precede6v6; no automatic campaign credit.
